method: Node.js unit and integration tests. API responses are explicit test fixtures, not live provider responses. No test policy is shipped in the application.

tests.name: Genesis contains no learned abilities, relationships, vocabulary or carried resources
Disconnected step makes zero requests and leaves the entire world unchanged
No timer advances an unconnected world
Non-Jev identity, unknown option, missing distribution and wrong sums are rejected
A valid typed Jev response commits exactly one action and advances one world turn
HTTP authentication failure produces no world changes and no automatic retry
Malformed success answer cannot trigger a fallback
Failed learning phase rolls back the entire uncommitted physical experiment
Request cap freezes a multi-phase turn with no partial resource changes
Receiver independently accepts an offer; total food is conserved
A Jev refusal causes no inventory transfer
Receiver gets observable token and gesture, never the current intended referent
Successful experiment plus supported Jev inference gives only the learner a skill
Unsupported experiment cannot grant a skill even when Jev chooses supported
A burning fire warms nearby others and loses finite fuel only on committed turns
Learning prerequisites block fire, metalworking and writing at genesis
Confidence gate rejects the whole turn without human override or local choice
Pause discards a late response even if a transport ignores cancellation
Exports never serialize the personal API key
World reset does not reset request usage or erase historical receipts
A hidden page or missing renderer makes no paid API call
Every committed turn references its complete set of Jev request receipts
